messages:
morgan: Kicking off batch-pin cutover for v2026.3. Plan: canary -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over next 40m. See release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.3 :sparkles:
deploy-bot: deploy initiated by @morgan. canary -> 2% traffic on runtime-pool-a. image: redwood/inference:v2026.3-canary
jasmin: quick sanity: can we verify model KV cache metrics + p99 latency before next step?
liam: running grafana panels now, pinging infra. kv-cache hit stable at 98%, p99 120ms on canary nodes. no errors in logs so far.
sarah: canary logs show a single spike of kvcache OOM on box eu-west-1b 14m ago, but evicted and recovered — file: /var/log/deploys/2026.3/canary-logs.txt. not correlated to user-facing 5xx.
morgan: ok good. next step to 5% in 8m. hold for any objections.
jasmin: +1. remind: EU region needs pin to v2026.3-eu-compat due to old quantization ABI. can we route EU users to pinned variant?
liam: created routing rule: region == eu -> v2026.3-eu-compat (no traffic shift). will enable at 5% cutover time if approved. rule id: rt-4392.
morgan: approve routing rule for EU. add to rollout notes.
deploy-bot: shifting global traffic to 5% for v2026.3. progress: 12% of shards updated, 3/4 LB refresh done. ETA ~2m.
sarah: monitoring: error rate flat, request time p50/p95 unchanged. alerting quiet.
jamin: (typo) jasmin: lol ignore prior typo :grimace:
morgan: ok moving to 20% now. ops please watch steady-state for 5m after shift. if error rate delta > 0.5% point abort and rollback.
liam: starting 20% rollout. patch notes pinned in console under Deploy 2026.3 -> notes.
sarah: i'm seeing a small increase in tail latency for token streaming routes in one region (us-east-2) up ~18ms p99. not fatal but worth tracking.
jasmin: can we temporarily reduce batch size for streaming model on those nodes? config: `runtime.config.streaming.max_batch=8`
liam: applied config change to us-east-2 subset. watching impact.
deploy-bot: 20% shift completed. autofallback policy active: fallback_variant=v2026.2 if SLA breach.
morgan: OK team — two checks: 1) anything blocking cutover to 50%? 2) do we pin version in EU prod? please respond quickly.
sarah: not blocking. EU pin is needed long-term but routing rule is fine for now.
jasmin: agree. no blockers from DX. we'll update release notes with EU caveat.
liam: infra thumbs-up. metrics look stable after batch-size tweak.
morgan: decision: proceed to 50% in 10m. if any >0.5% error delta or sustained p99 +40ms abort. otherwise continue to full.
sarah: noted. will escalate if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: scheduling 50% shift at 2198340068.
morgan: final check, anyone call for STOP?
jasmin: no stop from me.
liam: no stop.
sarah: no stop but keep an eye on us-east-2.
morgan: GO -> executing 50% shift now.
deploy-bot: shift started. progress logs: shards updated 20/40 -> 50%.
(deploy-bot): ALERT: automated regression detector flagged increased token-gen latency on subset of workers in us-east-2. delta p99 +52ms, sustained 3m.
morgan: pause. rollback criteria met (p99 > +40ms sustained). initiating rollback to v2026.2.
liam: rolling back traffic to previous variant and unapplying runtime config change.
sarah: rerouting EU back to v2026.2 as well.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic normalized to v2026.2. All shards at baseline.
morgan: postmortem notes: unexpected tail latency on streaming routes after batch-size change in us-east-2. action items: (1) revert default batch-size tweak, (2) deeper profiling on token-gen path with kv-cache, (3) run longer soak in us-east before 50% next attempt. I'll draft release update and schedule follow-up.
jasmin: will update release notes + customer comms draft.
liam: adding instrumentation ticket and scheduling regression-run against representative workloads.
sarah: marking incident in incidents channel and linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-regressions.
morgan: thanks all — rollout aborted for now. we'll reconvene after analysis. :white_check_mark:
